summary: Implemented the rich_measure/VerticalCenter feature by editing files only; no tests or repository code were run and nothing was committed. Changes: rich/tree.py adds an iterative Tree.__rich_measure__ (explicit stack, 4 cells per indent level) and the Measurement import; rich/align.py adds Align.__repr__, an Align width constraint (measured maximum, or the smaller of that and an explicit width), and a new VerticalCenter class with render, measure, and repr; rich/console.py passes justify="default" in print's render options while still collecting renderables with the justify argument; CHANGELOG.md marks 9.8.0 unreleased and adds an Added section with two entries; tests/test_align.py gains repr, vertical-center render, and measure tests; tests/test_tree.py gains a measure test expecting Measurement(11, 19). Verification was by reading only. The tree walk's level counter ends at -1 after the root iterator is exhausted, which has no effect on the result.
